name: 時刻の書式と外部の説明を調整する利用設定
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Targeted layout correction for LH07-0108. Image 1 controls radio anatomy, selected/unselected state and divider craft. Image 2 is the candidate to edit. Image 3 is the Japanese layout and typography reference. Image 4 is approved style. Keep the 390x284 landscape canvas. Match the preview: align the first heading at x=16,y=20. In Image 2 it is at x=23,y=36, so move it left7px and up16px. Keep the rest of the layout compact and aligned to Image 3: the option text begins near x=47, the second heading near x=16, and the footer stays small below the last divider. Remove the visually extra spaces between each option label and its parenthetical example; preserve exact strings: 時刻の書式; 12時間表記（例：午後2:00）; 24時間表記（例：14:00）; ウェブ上の説明を表示; 空のメモと、自分のメモの下に表示; プライバシーの説明・お問い合わせ. Keep the selected 12-hour and web-description radios forest green and the 24-hour radio neutral. Preserve existing radio size and the component-specific spacing; do not add blank margins, controls, cards or screen chrome.
reviewNotes: At390x284, labels, states and title scale are good. First heading/selected row about8-11px low; second heading/description row about10-15px high; footer8px high. Restore section rhythm with comfortable but compact spacing. Not complete or owner accepted.
